risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively detailed and well quantified, including fleet size, government-customer concentration, backlog conversion, COVID-19 costs, and bid-market share. Risk is moderated by recurring demand and strong federal project exposure, but material uncertainty remains from COVID-19 impacts, project delays, backlog variability, contract cancellation rights, and reliance on government spending.
